lines.en: : What do you mean you won’t wear the outfit I prepared for you? I always make the costumes for the second floor’s Dorm Wars contests.
: If this is a DEI thing, I can assure you I am more than qualified to-
: Apologies, but I had no idea you were preparing any sort of costume for me. I was never informed of this.
: Since when do I need to inform anyone to take their clothes off? I mean- to dress them in custom-tailored outfits?
: Nice save.
: If it’s the undressing you want, I welcome you to accompany me to the dressing room. But I regret to inform you I’ve brought my own outfit to change into.
: Since when do you own anything that could even apply to a goth fashion show? I’ve seen you wear two outfits in my life and they both just scream “coffee shop.”
: They’re not mine, per se. They belong to my mother. And most of her clothing fits the theme of this contest quite perfectly.
: Your mom isn’t actually Wakana, is she? Is that why you’ve had the hots for her this whole time? The incest kink? It’s all starting to make sense.
: Unfortunately, she is not.
: I’ll be perfectly fine on my own, though. Kyoko and I are about the same size now. I just hope I can do her justice.
: She was quite beautiful before she was confined to a computer chair for the rest of time.
: She sounds very...relatable.
: I take it you’ve also experienced inexplicable horrors then?
: Aye. I’m still playing Genshin Impact after five years and I do imagine there’s not much out there more horrifying than that.
: Are you ready, Ayane? I don’t think I’ve ever seen you wear anything goth-ish before. I’m kind of excited.
: Sana — you do know you don’t have to wear that anymore, right? You can put your regular clothes back on now.
: I know...I’m just tired after being up on stage for so long...so I think I’ll stay in this for a little while longer...
: I, for one, am proud of Sana’s new attitude. It means a lot to me as a fellow flatchester. Not like you’d understand, though.
: No...there is a lot I don’t understand all of a sudden.
: I am kind of nervous, though. But a little less about the outfit itself and more about the...question part.
: Really? But you’re always so confident about literally everything. What could somebody ask you that would throw you off?
: I...am confident. Yes. But I’m also friends with everyone in here. And I am extremely uncomfortable about how...open everyone suddenly is.
: You mean about my dad and how we all want to fuck him?
: ...yes, Ami. About your dad. And how we all want to fuck him.
: Well, if it’s any consolation, over a quarter of the class didn’t show up tonight! So it’s not like everything is lost yet!
: But yeah. I can see how you’d feel uncomfortable being surrounded by a bunch of whores. I am too, a little.
: I want to tell you to be nicer but, honestly, I’m surprised you can even exist in this environment without starting any problems.
: Hahah! Maybe I’ve just been softened up by being forced to listen to my dad blow my new mom’s back out every single night?
: Hah...
: Ami...do you need a hug or...something?
: No thanks, Sana. I just need to remain vigilant and keep my head on my shoulders to prevent anyone from running away with my dad.
: And also to make sure he doesn’t spend too long looking at girls who are obviously trying to appeal to his dark yet understandable nature through skimpy micro-bikinis.
: I think I’ll...go get changed now...
: Okay! You do that!
: Come on, Sana. We can get changed together.
: Okay. I hid Ayane’s outfit, which means we have a good ten minutes to do whatever we want before she finds it. Are you thinking what I’m thinking?
: Probably not since you’re in permanent sex mode now.
: The word “now” implies that I haven’t always been like this. Which is false from my perspective.
: But I understand that you see things differently and have experienced a different side of me that I have yet to discover.
: So, sure. I’ll let you be a pussy for ten more minutes if that makes you happy. I’m starting to get used to it anyway.
: Thanks, Maya. I appreciate that. And let me just say, this might be the closest you’ve come to being the real you since we re-met.
: Thank you. But also, fuck you.
: Irrefutable sexual tension aside, though — what the fuck is this?
: This as in...the Dorm Wars?
: Yes. I devoted my entire existence to hiding the fact that we were fucking at your behest. Now there are literal competitions about it? Why did I hide anything then?
: Why does everyone else get to be all gross and talk about fucking the teacher while the girl who’s been fucking the teacher since before any of them even met you gets shafted?
: Just not literally because, again, you’re a pussy now.
: This just sort of happened one day. And I’m sure I don’t need to tell you how much I like attention, so...I never really fought back.
: So you’re just...okay with being a predator now? Is this the sort of self-acceptance you’ve been seeking this whole time? Did prude Maya teach you this?
: I think it’s mostly the time loops and the fact that most consequences seem temporary now.
: Right...time.
: Tell me more about that. Who knows again? Just...you and Ayane? And Makoto, right?
: And Yumi.
: Not Ami, though.
: Right. And Ami can’t know under any circumstances. That was one thing the older you was extremely clear about.
: Gee, I wonder why.
: ...What?
: Listen — I want to learn more about this stuff. That’s what I tried telling you at Christmas.
: But I don’t want to be the only person broadening their horizons. Do you get what I’m saying here?
: I do...it’s just-
: Difficult. I know. Everything is always fucking difficult when it comes to us. But there’s still an us. And there’s still a me.
: I have just as many fucked up and stupid feelings as you. And if we’re really going to try this talking bullshit, I want something in return.
: I don’t want to be the only one who bends, Sensei. Unless it’s over a desk or a bed or a counter or something. Take me somewhere.
: What do you mean “somewhere?”
: I don’t know. Anywhere. Somewhere we can be alone so I can re-cultivate the relationship I want to have with you without the fear of Ami slitting my throat.
: You have that apartment, don’t you? The one you reluctantly, yet very violently, fingered me in when I ran away from the last Dorm Wars?
: You mean the one Chika lives in? She’s just as dangerous as Ami.
: Yeah, probably not. But like I said, I don’t care where it is. I just want to be alone with you.
: And I want it soon or chances are you are going to wake up to my thoughts on somnophilia and the most non-consensual handjob you’ve ever had.
: So...a date?
: Yes. But not one you are forced to go on as part of a competition. I would like you to pamper me and feed me and give me at least five orgasms.
: And yes, you can spread them out throughout the day if you are worried about getting tired. The end.
: Do that for me...and teach me about all this stupid time stuff...and I will become your Maya. The one you lost.
: That’s not something that happens overnight. I’m sure you know that. But it’ll be worth it if that’s what you’re looking for out of me.
: Plus, you get to fornicate with your niece’s best friend and jingle her bell whenever you like.
: Daughter. Ami is my daughter now.
: Sure. Whatever. Now, are you in or are you out? And where are we going when you say that you’re in?
: There’s...
: There’s a takoyaki stand.
: That’s...a place to start, right?
: What a terrible idea for a date. It’s exactly what I wanted.
: Laaaaaadies aaaaand gentlemeeeeeen!
: I’m sure I don’t need to tell you that intermission has concluded! So go on and make your way on over to the stage for the final competition in this year’s Dorm Wars!
: The score is currently: Floor 1 — [dormwars5floor1points]. Floor 2 — [dormwars5floor2points]. But just because that’s the score now doesn’t mean this thing is over!
: Especially not with our track record of bonus points being earned between the final contest and the closing ceremony!
: That’s something we can talk about tomorrow, though. Because tonight...fate will show its face once more! The river will continue to flow!
: What?
: Schroedinger’s cat is out of the bag and into the fire! And when the last customer leaves, you know it’s time to close up shop!
: Uta, what the fuck are you talking about?
: I don’t know! But give it up for Ayane Amamiya and her sexy new goth look!
: Thank you, Uta. And thank you, Sensei — for all of the thoughts you’ll spend on me the next time you’re alone in bed.
: Damn, Ayane. I’ll admit, I was kinda worried about turnin’ a preppy girl into a walkin’ Hot Topic. But I think you’ve pulled it off!
: I’m glad the...dress fits...
: Not everything...Miss Watabe gave me...uhh...matches my...size...
: And just because I know everyone’s wondering — yes. I did her makeup.
: No one was wondering that.
: I was. Excellent work, Nithhala. You have clearly been grinding lately.
: Yeah well, there’s not much else to do without a phone.
: You look...really beautiful, Ayane...I’m not convinced there’s anything you can’t pull off now.
: Question o-
: If you even think about asking me some sort of inappropriate question, I will reveal to everyone who you really are right here and now.
: Fair. I’ll let Noriko field this one then.
: Okay, Ayane! First and foremost — you’re hot!
: Second, though — I need you to close your eyes. It’s important for this first question.
: Works for me. Darkness is all I see as a lady of the night anyway.
: Ayane, that means prostitute.
: Wait, does it really?
: Ah! Eyes closed!
: Whoops. Sorry.
: Question one — you’re alone on the beach. It’s raining. There are three crabs to your right and a shovel to your left. The date is January 19th.
: You’ve just finished binging the third season of a show on Netflix that’s being taken off due to licensing issues next week and are not sure you’ll complete the series in time.
: I was binging it on the beach?
: In your room in a cabin on the beach. You’re taking a break right now.
: Got it.
: Noriko, what the fuck is this question?
: Hold on! I’m not done! So anyway, you’re on the beach. Crabs. Shovel. Netflix. But there’s an asteroid too! Way, way up in the clouds!
: You’re the first person to spot it and you can feel in your heart of hearts that it’s going to destroy Japan.
: How do you save the world using only the objects at your disposal? Or how do you spend your final moments? Bonus points if you save the world.
: Why were my questions not as complex as this one? Why do I have to scissor the teacher’s daughter?
: We can...scissor her together...
: Please don’t.
: Hmm...quite the predicament. Quite...the predicament.
: Well, Noriko — I think I’d start by observing the crabs.
: Animals are known to run from disaster, so if they make a break for the water, I may follow them and simply attempt to survive the apocalypse. I’m good at that.
: Next — I throw the shovel at the asteroid to try and knock it off course.
: Roll to hit.
: I don’t have dice.
: You miss.
: The asteroid is about to make contact!
: I wake up and it was all a dream.
: Beautiful. You win. Pack it up, girls. Contest is over.
: At least let Nodoka go first! She’s the one on our team!
: Question two — which will also be the last question since the first one took up too much time. How would you describe your ideal life?
: Like...where do I want to be in ten years?
: Ten...twenty...maybe even five for all we know! Just what would make you happiest and what would a perfect life really be to you?
: Well...I’ve kind of been saying it from the beginning.
: I think a perfect life for me would be getting married and having as many babies as Sensei is willing to put inside of me.
: Even if that number is zero?
: I figure I can talk him into one at least. A girl, hopefully. I’d want to see how he is with a daughter. I think it’d be really cute once the reluctance wears off.
: Ahem.
: Oh, scratch that. I know it’d be really cute because Ami is his daughter and Sensei loves Ami more than anything. So I’d want that for my daughter too.
: You’re off the hook. Still not gonna happen, though. If anyone is having Sensei’s babies, it’s me.
: We’ll see about that.
Ayane gets off the stage, winking at me before taking her place off to the side and allowing Nodoka to come up.
Which she...certainly does. And not a second too late.
: Well, hello everyone. I’m so sorry to have kept you waiting. I couldn’t get my little hat to stay on right.
: I want to wear the little hat.
: You want to wear every hat.
: Yet I never hat! Why no hat?! And why Nodoka hot when not supposed to be?!
: Nodoka...you...look stunning...
: Yet I am nothing compared to you, my sweet. This body is not fit to serve as an appetizer so long as you are on the menu.
: What about me? Do me next.
: Help me take these boots off later tonight and I will do whatever your little heart desires, Uta-chan.
: Can you just stay like this forever please?
: I’ll think about it. Now, does anyone have any real questions for me? Maybe about shovels or...scissoring?
: Question one — if you had to fuck any girl in the class-
: Futaba, obviously. I’ve been dreaming about it for years, after all.
: I could have just told you that. I’m not happy about it, though.
: Okay, new question — where do I rank in the top twenty?
: The bottom ten. You want it too much. And where’s the fun in that?
: I think I’m just gonna kill myself. That seems to make the most sense for me right now.
: Do I get the next question then?
: You get all of them from now on. I am dead.
: Okay! Nodoka — you’re on a bus that’s moving backwards. And you just passed a convenience store staffed by large, animatronic cats.
: They need your help composing a song in order to revitalize the town. But the town is full of nephilim godkin with cauliflower ear and misophonia!
: What is your song about and what is it called?
: It’s called “The Rotten Circle.” And it’s about what happens when a wish makes a wish.
: How does that revitalize a town?
: It doesn’t — for I seek not to appease the children of gods but rather torment them the way they torment those I care for.
: Uhh...rad! You pass as well!
: Which brings us to our final question — why did Yumi beat the shit out of you that one time?
: Noriko, I don’t think that’s something you should-
: No, I seriously need to know. I’ve gotten close enough to her by now to know that she’s the type to run away before actually hurting someone.
: So Yumi just waltzing across the room and punching Nodoka in the teeth is weird as hell to me. That’s not like her.
: That’s still not something you should ask her in front of everyone, though. It’s probably personal.
: Yeah, because Nodoka would never try and drag personal information out of anyone up on stage. Right, Nodoka?
: My my. It appears that the class may be turning against me. This outfit is even more cursed than I thought.
: Nodoka...telling them would be a step in the right direction. It’s a chance to show everyone you do have a heart.
: It’s because I have a heart that happened at all. If I were the emotionless heathen I’m made out to be, I never would have pried in the first place.
: So...you did do something then. To provoke Yumi.
: Of course I did. It’s as you said — she’d never attack someone for no reason, would she?
: You let her get expelled over that...
: I mean...she did beat Nodoka halfway to death. I think that warrants punishment, even if it was provoked.
: Provoked or not, Nodoka went out of her way to involve herself in my issues. Again. Because she thinks I can’t handle them myself. That’s what it was, right?
: It was a lot of things — but I regret none of them as they have led me here. And I am the closest to “happy” now that I have ever been.
: I suppose I may have gone slightly overboard, though. Whoopsie.
: Hah...
: It’s okay, Futaba. Nodoka is defective.
: Yes...
: But I wish she’d go be defective somewhere else sometimes...
: She can promise you that she feels the same way.
: And that everything “wrong” she ever does can be traced back to that.
: Okay, Sensei! Despite this competition being slightly less sexy than the last one, we still saw some hot stuff and you still have to make a decision!
: So, who’s it gonna be this time? The girl who escaped the apocalypse?! Or the girl who probably wants one?! Choose wisely!
Ayane
: I think I’m gonna have to go with Ayane.
: Yay! I’m actually in this one and not just the benefactor of sudden favoritism this time!
: Yay! Babymaking is still a go! Time to make Ami an aunt!
: Congratulations, Ayane. I’d stick my tongue down your throat if there were not another human between us right now.
: Thank you for being alive, Uta!
: Don’t mention it, Ayane!
Nodoka
: I think I’m gonna have to go with Nodoka.
: Wait — so I won every competition you got to choose for except the one I was actually in?! How does that work?!
: Yeah, what? I don’t get this at all.
: Perhaps he chose based on which girl he’d like to tie up and edge the most?
: No, because then he would have chosen me.
: She’s not wrong.
: What is this then? I don’t...get how I’m supposed to feel.
: Then just assume I’m doing it to tease you. That’s always a safe assumption if I repeatedly embarrass you.
: And how should I interpret you choosing me?
: Interpret it as you looking really fucking hot in that dress.
: It shall be done. Thank you for your lust, father.
Nodoka
: I think I’m gonna have to go with Nodoka.
: Oh?
: Only in terms of the outfits. I still prefer Ayane in virtually every other way. No offense.
: None taken. I like you more when you abuse me anyway.
: Guess I can’t pull this style off after all...hahah.
: No, you look great. I just think your...normal style suits you a little better while this is more up Nodoka’s alley.
: What about me? Do you think I can pull off dark and gloomy?
: Maybe visually. Attitude wise? Not a chance.
: Yeah. That’s fair.
: Anyway! With the conclusion of the goth girl glamour gala, we have officially completed all of the endorsed Dorm Wars competitions!
: Will there be more behind the scenes? Who knows?! Probably Sensei! And the rest of us will just have to wait for our turn or...however this works! I’m still new to this stuff!
: Uta! Come put your Chipotle order in. You’re the only one we’re still waiting on.
: Ah! Sorry! Bye, Sensei! Don’t forget me if bonus things happen! I might not compete, but I still want to watch!
